activity_summary: Margery Pell had the morning already, and her figure was two hundred, from talk on the stair, not from a count of coats in the road. Cowley had a boy's account: apprentices, one man, a gate, and no count. Larkham would not invent a third figure. The only sentence Cowley and Larkham both accepted was that people were running toward the noise. Cowley proposed going down to see which story was true. You would not. You had seen the open gate, the wrenched hasp, the cap and the backs, and not a man brought out. Nobody went.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused to go down, and named only what he had seen.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Gave two hundred as her figure from the stair, and sent them back to the house.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Brought a boy's account with no count, proposed going down, and stayed when you said no.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Refused a third figure, and wrote the agreement as the running only.

entities.name: Bedlam
entities.context: Mentioned in Two hundred, and a road you will not take

facets.activity: Made them say the one sentence they shared

quotes.speaker: margery_pell
quotes.text: Two hundred, if I am to put one figure on it.

quotes.speaker: richard_cowley
quotes.text: Then someone should go down and see which story is true.
